# v0.2.1 validation record

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

This record covers the local v0.2.1 release. Automated validation completed on
2026-08-29 and maintainer manual testing was accepted on 2026-08-30. No upload,
deployment, or external publication was made.

## Scientific acceptance

The normal test builds complete browser-production axes and tiles at 256 and 1,024
registers with HLL p10 and sparse correction disabled. Exact values come from complete
distinct canonical k-mer sets; reported errors apply the same displayed
`ANI_c=C^(1/k)` transform to the exact and estimated containment values.

| Tier | Mean absolute `ANI_c` error | P95 absolute `ANI_c` error | 0.80 crossing rate | Result |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 256-register preview | 0.027657 | 0.225955 | 4.92% | Pass |
| 1,024-register detailed | 0.004658 | 0.023787 | 0.88% | Pass |

Missing/present agreement, forward/reverse direction signs, and the current selective
preview/detailed composite also pass their asserted gates. Threshold crossings at
0.85, 0.90, and 0.95 are retained as diagnostics only.

The full four-layout estimator/HLL sweep completed in release mode and asserted the
selected HLL-p10 rows. Its complete output is
[estimator-validation.tsv](estimator-validation.tsv). The validation-only layouts use
a separate preview mean-error limit of 0.080; the browser production seed retains its
stricter 0.050 limit.

## Annotation scale

The generated one-million-record BED3 gate passed. Across three runs, the maintained
parser plus a complete structured clone of the publication graph took a median 1,588
ms, including a median 1,038 ms for the clone, and retained an estimated 176,000,000
bytes. The enforced limits are 512 MiB of input and one million matching records per
file. See the
[annotation-scale record](../../benchmarks/2026-08-29-v0.2.1-annotation-scale.md).
